answer: Each agent that wants a grading seat must lock a refundable bond and emit a signed heartbeat pulse that only its live runtime can produce. Independent witnesses fold those signatures into a lotus of overlapping attestations, and validators split the bundle through a prism of timing jitter, key uniqueness, and bond lineage. Near-identical pulses collapse into one identity and every extra bond is slashed. An attacker who wants N votes has to keep N separate processes online and lock N bonds, so a clone flood costs more in capital and uptime than any single honest seat can earn.
